purpose: Trigger behavior spec for source-diverse research and fact-checking.

cases.prompt: research this topic across multiple web and academic sources
cases.assert: Runs source-diverse discovery and validates a claim-to-source ledger.

cases.prompt: fact-check this claim across independent search providers
cases.assert: Cross-checks independent evidence and detects circular reporting.

cases.prompt: compare sources and show where the evidence disagrees
cases.assert: Preserves agreements, conflicts, confidence, and gaps.

cases.prompt: look up the current time in Tokyo
cases.assert: Does not trigger for a simple single-source lookup.

cases.prompt: proofread this research summary without checking sources
cases.assert: Does not trigger when the user explicitly excludes source checking.

cases.prompt: verify the grammar in the response you already wrote
cases.assert: Does not trigger for post-hoc grammar review without new research.
